title: File system | Node.js v26.12.1 Documentation
claims: fs.realpath resolves dot segments and symbolic links
lstat observes a link itself rather than its referent
a canonical pathname is not unique because hard links and bind mounts can expose the same entity
notes: Candidate local filesystem primitive; path text alone is not a containment proof.

title: Child process | Node.js v26.12.1 Documentation
claims: spawn creates an asynchronous subprocess and stdio pipes have finite, platform-specific capacity
exec starts a shell while execFile starts its target directly by default
killing a parent on Linux does not terminate its descendants
notes: Candidate local command primitive; process-tree containment needs OS-level qualification.

title: node-pty README
claims: node-pty exposes pseudoterminal reads and writes
it supports Linux, macOS, and Windows through ConPTY on supported Windows versions
launched processes run at the parent permission level
notes: Candidate interactive terminal dependency; pin a release and qualify native builds before adoption.

title: Reparse Points
claims: reparse points can alter file-open behavior
NTFS links and mounted folders use reparse points
notes: Windows path-boundary candidate; native handle semantics require target-platform tests.

title: Job Objects
claims: a job object manages associated processes as a unit
job operations can enforce limits and terminate associated processes
notes: Candidate Windows process-tree owner; nesting and assignment behaviour require qualification.

title: Docker Engine security
claims: Docker creates namespaces and cgroups for containers
namespaces isolate process and network views
hardening and daemon/configuration surfaces remain part of the security boundary
notes: Candidate Linux executor; a container is not equivalent to a complete credential or egress policy.

title: Introduction to gVisor security
claims: gVisor is an application-kernel isolation layer
its Sentry uses restricted host primitives and can run with mount and user namespaces
compatibility and configuration remain workload concerns
notes: Candidate OCI runtime; measure compatibility and mount/egress policy for selected images.

title: Firecracker microVMs
claims: Firecracker uses KVM to create microVMs
the VMM exposes a control API and resource rate limiters
the jailer is an additional user-space security boundary
notes: Candidate Linux microVM substrate; host hardware virtualization and image lifecycle are qualification gates.

title: E2B repository
claims: the JavaScript SDK creates sandboxes and runs commands
the project documents self-hosted infrastructure and cloud-provider deployment
notes: Candidate managed or self-hosted remote executor; exact isolation, retention, and egress terms must be pinned per deployment.

title: Daytona Sandboxes
claims: Daytona exposes container, VM, Windows, macOS, and GPU sandbox classes
the documentation makes region and snapshot part of sandbox selection
nested virtualization is separately enabled for Linux VM sandboxes
notes: Candidate managed executor; provider identity, region, persistence, and cleanup need observed receipts.

title: RFC 4251: The Secure Shell Protocol Architecture
claims: SSH provides secure remote login and network services
the architecture separates transport, user authentication, and multiplexed connection channels
host-key verification is an explicit trust decision
notes: Remote transport is not executor authorization or an effect receipt.

title: Pi extension documentation at pinned commit
claims: Pi extensions run in process
Pi provides tool and lifecycle extension seams
extension code has the host process authority
notes: Pinned source contract, not installed-runtime evidence.
